about_the_game:
Note: The offer is available as part of the Warhammer Skulls Sale, running in WoT Blitz from May 22 through May 29.
If you already have this vehicle, you will receive 3,500 gold as compensation. Compensation for each camouflage is 950 gold.

This bundle includes:

• Vindicator UM
• Garage slot
• 9 equipment slots for the Vindicator UM
• Dark Angels Legendary camouflage
• Imperial Fists Legendary camouflage
• 30 certificates for x5 XP for the Vindicator UM
• Ultramarines profile background
• Flaming Aquila Animated avatar
• Primaris Intercessor Legendary avatar

The Vindicator Ultramarines is a tank destroyer armed with a large-caliber gun that can inflict heavy single-shot damage. Its solid frontal armor features additional protection in the form of a daunting dozer blade.

This DLC can be added to your World of Tanks Blitz account only once.
